import sys,json,time,socket
from types import SimpleNamespace
from unittest.mock import patch
from contextlib import ExitStack
from pathlib import Path
root,label=sys.argv[1:];sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(root)/'app'))
def no_network(*args,**kwargs):raise AssertionError('offline probe')
with ExitStack() as guards:
 for t in ['socket.socket.connect','socket.socket.connect_ex','socket.socket.sendto','socket.create_connection','socket.getaddrinfo']:guards.enter_context(patch(t,new=no_network))
 import numpy as np
 import idvb0059_steady as steady
 refs=[]
 for i in range(6):
  mask=np.zeros((2048,2048),np.uint8);mask[16:-16,16:-16]=1;mask[32:-32:32,32:-32]=0
  refs.append(SimpleNamespace(clean_mask=mask,validation_mask=mask.copy(),known_boundary=np.zeros_like(mask),unknown_mask=np.zeros_like(mask),metadata={}))
 products=[steady.prepare(r) for r in refs];misses=0;timings=[]
 for i in range(30):
  tick=time.perf_counter();result=steady.prepare(refs[i%6]);timings.append((time.perf_counter()-tick)*1000)
  misses+=result is not products[i%6];products[i%6]=result
 print(json.dumps(dict(source=label,scope='negative case: six distinct cross-map resources; holds caller products for identity check, no RSS inference',shapeHW=[2048,2048],calls=30,misses=misses,entries=len(steady._cache),timingsMs=timings)))
